---

## Core Land Surveying Services (Unique Survey)
Specialized land surveying solutions utilizing high-precision Electronic Total Stations, RTK Dual-Frequency DGPS GNSS, and Survey UAV Drones.

- [Counter Survey (Contour Survey)](https://uecivil.com/services?survey=contour-survey): High-accuracy elevation counter levels, slope analysis, and cut-fill earthwork volume calculation at 0.25m, 0.5m, or 1.0m intervals.
- [Land Topography Survey](https://uecivil.com/services?survey=topography-survey): Comprehensive physical, natural, and structural ground feature mapping with AutoCAD (.DWG/.DXF) plans, spot levels, and georeferenced coordinates.
- [Point Marking & Boundary Demarcation](https://uecivil.com/services?survey=point-marking): Physical on-ground pegging, stone pillar fixing, and revenue survey number demarcation correlating 7/12 land records with satellite coordinates to prevent boundary disputes.
- [DGPS & RTK Geodetic Survey](https://uecivil.com/services?survey=dgps-survey): Multi-constellation GNSS millimeter georeferencing, geodetic baseline fixing, and permanent temporary benchmark (TBM) installation.
- [Drone & UAV Aerial Survey](https://uecivil.com/services?survey=drone-survey): Aerial photogrammetry, high-resolution orthomosaic imagery, 3D digital surface models (DSM/DTM), and volumetric calculations for large acreage.
- [Plot Layout Demarcation & Setting Out](https://uecivil.com/services?survey=layout-demarcation): Architectural layout setting out, building column marking, and plot subdivision aligned with municipal TP schemes.
- [Road, Canal & Pipeline Alignment Survey](https://uecivil.com/services?survey=road-alignment): Centerline alignment pegging, longitudinal (L-sections) and cross-sectional (X-sections) profile levelling.

---

## Civil Laboratory Testing Equipment (Unique Engineering)
Complete catalog of ISI and ASTM compliant testing equipment for civil engineering, infrastructure, and construction material quality control.

- [Cement, Concrete & Aggregate Testing Equipment](https://uecivil.com/products?category=cement-concrete): Compression Testing Machines (CTM 2000kN / 3000kN Digital & Semi-Automatic), Concrete Test Rebound Hammers, Concrete Cube Moulds (150mm & 70.6mm), Slump Test Apparatus, Vibrating Tables, Flexural Testing Machines.
- [Soil Testing Equipment](https://uecivil.com/products?category=soil-testing): Direct Shear Apparatus (Motorized/Digital), California Bearing Ratio (CBR) Test Apparatus, Liquid Limit Device (Casagrande & Cone Penetrometer), Proctor Compaction Apparatus, Core Cutters, Sand Replacement Apparatus.
- [Bitumen & Asphalt Testing Equipment](https://uecivil.com/products?category=bitumen-testing): Bitumen Penetrometer (Digital & Standard), Ductility Testing Machine, Ring and Ball Softening Point Apparatus, Marshall Stability Test Apparatus, Flash and Fire Point Apparatus (Cleveland / Pensky Martens), Thin Film Oven.
- [Survey & Measuring Instruments](https://uecivil.com/products?category=survey-instruments): Electronic Total Stations (1" and 2" angular accuracy), Auto Levels (24x, 32x), Digital Theodolites, RTK DGPS GNSS Receivers, Aluminum Heavy-Duty Tripods, Levelling Staves, Prism Poles.
- [Construction Machinery & Lab Plant](https://uecivil.com/products?category=construction-machinery): Laboratory Concrete Pan Mixers, Motorized Sieve Shakers, Core Drilling Machines, Accelerated Curing Tanks.
- [Safety Products & Site PPE](https://uecivil.com/products?category=safety-products): ISI Certified Safety Helmets, High-Visibility Reflective Safety Jackets, Steel Toe Safety Shoes, Site Barricade Tapes.
